body:
Since GH-64766 (in 3.1.0rc0), the C engine opens UTF-8 input in binary mode, so a text buffer such as `StringIO` is wrapped in `_BytesIOWrapper`, which encoded the text without an errors handler. `pd.read_csv(StringIO("a\nx\udcef\n"), encoding_errors="replace")` gave `['x?']` on 3.0.6 and raises `UnicodeEncodeError` on main. This passes `get_handle`'s `errors` through to the wrapper.

The C-engine part is a regression that hasn't shipped in a final release, so it gets no whatsnew. The pyarrow engine already went through the wrapper in 3.0.6 and raised there too, so that part gets a 3.1.0 whatsnew entry. This should be backported to 3.1.x.

AI disclosure: drafted with Claude Code (`claude opus 5.5 (high)`), used to find the bug while fuzzing read_csv against 3.0.6, write the fix and test, and review it.
title: BUG: read_csv ignored encoding_errors for text buffers on the C and pyarrow engines
